confidence_notes: Medium confidence: holistic estimates from general knowledge of Hong Kong price levels, brought forward to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are steadier; hostel and hotel rates move with tourism demand and are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.1x and 1.8x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The RBA rate came from search-result summaries, not a direct read of the live table, so verify it before conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; estimates reflect Hong Kong's own price levels from general knowledge. The HKD is pegged to the USD in a 7.75-7.85 band, which keeps USD anchors stable against local prices.
